newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends weaker but off lows.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed weaker but above session lows in what market sources saw as a gradual and continuing downtrend.
A bout of late-session speculative selling pushed spot March closer to support at 10.29 cents a lb to a daily low of 10.35 cents.
Prices recovered slightly from the lows by the close. March finished at 10.38, down 0.17, after trading from 10.48 to 10.35. The back months ended off 0.11 to 0.05.
Today's volume was estimated at 10,800 lots.
The trade and the speculators took turns selling the market down throughout today's session, and a lack of buying interest eased the move lower, dealers said.
A dearth of physical offtake continues to weigh on prices and is likely to push the March contract to 10.00 and possibly lower, within the month.
"No one can sell any sizable quantity of sugar," a broker said. "Anyone who would have a large requirement is not facing high internal prices, so there is no business of any consequence."
